zh: 顾客和会员积分。SuXin POS · 顾客
顾客清单：电话、积分、来了几次、花了多少
en: Phone, points, visits and spending for each customer

zh: 会员卡：扫卡号，或手机感应 NFC 卡
en: Member card: scan its number, or tap an NFC card

zh: 设置 → 积分：每 RM1 得几分，几分可以抵钱
en: Settings → Loyalty: points per ringgit and what they are worth

zh: 顾客要求删除资料（PDPA）：按「删除顾客资料」
en: A customer asks to be removed (PDPA): Remove customer data

zh: 90 天后自动删除，收据保留但没有名字
en: Erased after 90 days; receipts stay, without the name

zh: 全部顾客可以导出 Excel
